title: Building with the Claude API, a Claude Academy credential

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Here's a small win from October 2026. Anthropic issued Antoine a Claude Academy credential called Building with the Claude API.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A course certificate. What does an API course cover?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Per the post, the request shape, tool use and streaming. Those are the pieces a client uses to talk to Claude and let it call tools.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And it's one of three, right?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, all from the same month, all issued by Anthropic. The other two are Claude Platform 101 and an Introduction to Model Context Protocol. This note focuses on the API course.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So where does it connect to his own work?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Through uml-mcp. That's his M C P server that renders Mermaid, PlantUML and Kroki diagrams straight from a chat client. Model Context Protocol is the protocol behind it, and the API course covers the request, tool use and streaming ideas an M C P client relies on.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the course is the theory behind a tool he already built.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's a nice way to see it. You ask for a diagram in conversation, the client calls the tool, and the picture comes back. The course explains the plumbing under that exchange.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Short and sweet. Where can people see the credential?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: On the CV, next to the other Claude Academy items, and in the original post. The written page has the list with the credential names.
